method.images: Original native PNGs decoded losslessly to 8-bit RGB with Pillow. No PNG was edited, substituted or recomposited. Array comparisons use signed 16-bit differences to prevent unsigned wraparound.
method.threshold: A pixel changes when max(abs(R1-R2),abs(G1-G2),abs(B1-B2)) > 24, exactly as the frozen checkpoint. The original 0.01 ratio limit remains unchanged.
method.bounds: All crop and difference bounds use [left, top, rightExclusive, bottomExclusive].
method.fullDeviceBandRationale: Full image width and floor(stage top)..ceil(stage bottom), from the measured native stage [115,371.25,1050,525], also enclosing the phone extending left of the stage.
method.rawHash: SHA256 of row-major decoded 8-bit RGB bytes. Threshold-mask hashes use one 0/1 uint8 per full-image pixel.
method.coverage: For the constant-background question crop, per-channel coverage a_c=(B_c-P_c)/(B_c-F_c), F=(37,53,38), B=(250,249,247). Edge samples satisfy 0.05 < mean(a_c) < 0.95. Channel spread is max(a_c)-min(a_c). These numerical mode labels do not identify a compositor cause.

conclusions: The latest failing 1280 device raster is exactly the earlier two-state raster reversed between protected and source, not a new measured content, shape or styling difference.
The current touch trace proves one observed successful native close lifecycle on both pages, with strict focus/dismissal/unlock assertions active.
The latest Writing checkpoint remains failed by its unchanged raster gate.
causalLimits: The retained original first-pinned failure had no close trace; the latest successful trace cannot establish the earlier event order or prove that failure was a timer race.
Pixel coverage and byte identities establish recurring raster variants but do not establish layer promotion, header suppression, FAQ refresh or any specific browser operation as the cause.
Same-mode cross-run image equality is diagnostic evidence, not permission to substitute a different run or frame in the checkpoint.
Chrome-only CI evidence and emulated touch do not establish other browser, physical-device, native zoom or accessibility certification.
changesByThisReview: This JSON record only. No runtime, screenshot, harness, threshold, mask or workflow changed.
